content.short: Arculus is a hardware wallet storing private keys on a metal card and signing transactions via NFC.
content.description: Arculus is a hardware wallet that stores private keys on a durable metal card and signs transactions over NFC, keeping your keys secure. It employs a unique 3-factor authentication method to add security without sacrificing usability. The Key Card works in concert with the Wallet App to deliver a secure, intuitive solution for storing and managing your crypto and NFT assets across supported networks, including Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and others.
